lines.text: David says a Philistine giant should strike him, and calls that rebuke an act of loving devotion.
David says the people will listen to his pleasant words, and bones are scattered like a potter smashing a jar.

problems.problem: "Moabite king" and "righteous man" aren't the same kind of thing (one is a name, one isn't).
Its wrong detail "wind scatters chaff" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "one plows and breaks up the soil" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
